newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT group to launch 2nd Philippine satellite.
newsitem.headline: PLDT group to launch 2nd Philippine satellite.

text.p: A consortium led by Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co will launch the country's second satellite in March next year, the Department of Transportation and Communications (DOTC) said on Wednesday.

Communications Undersecretary Josefina Lichauco told reporters that officials of the Mabuhay Philippine Satellite Corp in a recent meeting confirmed the launching date of the $230 million satellite named Agila II.

Aside from PLDT, other members of the consortium are PT Pasifik Nusantara, China Everbright International Ltd, Philippine firm Republic Broadcasting Entertainment Corp and the Philippines Communications Satellite Co Inc.
The satellite will make use of an orbital slot at 153 degrees east longitude, Lichauco said.
The PLDT-led group launched the country's first satellite in November to provide communications services at the APEC summit by buying an existing satellite from PT Pasifik Satelit.
